gitCommit.subject: Design: workflow overhaul spec + Epic 0 (binary-insertion ranking engine) (#259)
gitCommit.body:
Design: workflow overhaul spec + Epic 0 (binary-insertion ranking engine) (#259)

* docs(design): workflow overhaul + DS refresh design spec

Two adversarial passes (full panel + focused Epic 0). Binary-insertion
ranking (Love+Like, recompute-from-log), timed rounds, unified Decide,
story (forward-framed), Build/Sort/Decide modes, handoff visual refresh
+ TierBadge. Foundation-first: Epic 0 (ranking engine) leads.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01MWzAwirwKSV1TDYnGmZ8fn

* docs(plan): Epic 0 binary-insertion ranking — task-by-task TDD plan

11 tasks: pure insertion engine (unit TDD) -> schema (orderRank + clientKey
partial indexes) -> repo -> ScoringService (drop Elo) -> orderRank assignment
-> live selector -> decisions idempotency + row-lock -> finalize rewire ->
clean-reset drafts + delete dead PairingService.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01MWzAwirwKSV1TDYnGmZ8fn

* feat(ranking): latestOutcome — latest-wins comparison lookup

* feat(ranking): placeItem — bounded binary-search placement with tie/skip

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* feat(ranking): deriveOrder — deterministic insertion replay + next pair

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* feat(db): add preferences.order_rank + decision_events.client_key with partial unique indexes

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* test(db): verify partial-index predicates behaviorally (order_rank, client_key)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* test(db): assert partial-index predicate via pg_indexes.indexdef; correct misleading comment

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* feat(preferences): persist orderRank + bulk clearOrderRanks

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* refactor(ranking): drop Elo pairwise deltas; latest-triage-wins bucket seed

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* feat(ranking): assign dense orderRank from insertion engine on recalculate

Wire the pure binary-insertion engine (deriveOrder) into
PreferenceStateService.recalculatePreferences: top+high items now carry a
dense order_rank (0 = most loved) derived from the curator's pairwise
comparisons; medium/low and unplaced items stay null. Clear-then-assign
avoids the partial-unique transient collision. New repo deps (item, session,
decision) are wired tx-bound in PreferenceController.fromDb so the whole
recompute stays inside the caller's transaction.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* feat(sort): drive next-pair selection from the insertion engine

Rewrite selectNextPair to delegate to deriveOrder (the same pure engine
recompute uses) so the live Sort round and PreferenceStateService ask the
same next question. Rankable set = top/high preference buckets minus
disposed items; RankItem uses each item's own createdAt; comparisons are
built via a new shared toComparisonEvents mapping reused by both entry
points. Selector now takes the session decisions (not a pre-derived
decidedPairs set); the page threads them through unchanged in return shape.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* feat(decisions): idempotency key + session row-lock on recompute

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* fix(sort): update disposition-exclusion test to selectNextPair decisions signature (Task 8 regression)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* feat(finalize): rank by bucket+orderRank; keep unranked-but-loved items

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* chore(ranking): clean-reset Elo-era drafts; remove dead PairingService

Forward-only DML migration 0012 deletes DRAFT sort_results (and their
now-orphaned sort_result_items) whose computedRank derives from the retired
Elo/pairwise scoring; finalized results are immutable self-contained snapshots
and are untouched. Deletes the dead PairingService class + its test (the live
pair selector is the free function in src/lib/pairwise-selection.ts; grep
confirmed no non-test importers). Behavioral integration test proves the reset
logic (draft + its item gone, finalized + its item preserved) plus a guard that
PairingService is no longer importable.

* refactor(ranking): consolidate RANKABLE_BUCKETS; harden reset test + engine skip coverage; type + doc notes (whole-branch review)

* docs: sync API + ARCHITECTURE for Epic 0 binary-insertion ranking

Design: workflow overhaul spec + Epic 0 (binary-insertion ranking engine) (#259)

* docs(design): workflow overhaul + DS refresh design spec

Two adversarial passes (full panel + focused Epic 0). Binary-insertion
ranking (Love+Like, recompute-from-log), timed rounds, unified Decide,
story (forward-framed), Build/Sort/Decide modes, handoff visual refresh
+ TierBadge. Foundation-first: Epic 0 (ranking engine) leads.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01MWzAwirwKSV1TDYnGmZ8fn

* docs(plan): Epic 0 binary-insertion ranking — task-by-task TDD plan

11 tasks: pure insertion engine (unit TDD) -> schema (orderRank + clientKey
partial indexes) -> repo -> ScoringService (drop Elo) -> orderRank assignment
-> live selector -> decisions idempotency + row-lock -> finalize rewire ->
clean-reset drafts + delete dead PairingService.

* feat(ranking): assign dense orderRank from insertion engine on recalculate

Wire the pure binary-insertion engine (deriveOrder) into
PreferenceStateService.recalculatePreferences: top+high items now carry a
dense order_rank (0 = most loved) derived from the curator's pairwise
comparisons; medium/low and unplaced items stay null. Clear-then-assign
avoids the partial-unique transient collision. New repo deps (item, session,
decision) are wired tx-bound in PreferenceController.fromDb so the whole
recompute stays inside the caller's transaction.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UGfELtYtZF1RffHyzJiuyC

* feat(sort): drive next-pair selection from the insertion engine

Rewrite selectNextPair to delegate to deriveOrder (the same pure engine
recompute uses) so the live Sort round and PreferenceStateService ask the
same next question. Rankable set = top/high preference buckets minus
disposed items; RankItem uses each item's own createdAt; comparisons are
built via a new shared toComparisonEvents mapping reused by both entry
points. Selector now takes the session decisions (not a pre-derived
decidedPairs set); the page threads them through unchanged in return shape.
